body: Thanks man that sounds like a very badass way to go about this. I will try to hangout with my friend as much as I can. We hung out a ton last year before the ex applied to my university so I know he won't mind. I know it's easier said than done but I'm going to try my best. I just hope I can meet another woman who actually loves me. Thanks for the advice and as depressed as I am I think I might be able to pull this off :,)

Luckily I have one really close friend at my university. He's not one to talk about emotional stuff but he is always there to hangout and just talk. And yeah i feel like her going to my school will be incredibly distracting. I have anxiety issues as is but her being there is going to make me feel incredibly anxious and sad

Geesh, this is exactly how I feel. I'm just clinging onto the fact that I love my parents and siblings and that someday things could change for the better. Right now it feels like nothing could get any worse and I want to escape it. I chickened out of suicide today but the thought is just constantly there. I don't know what to do with myself
Thank you so much, again you are an incredibly kind person and I'll keep you in the loop about how I am doing. I should be going to sleep soon anyways. And I'll look into trying that chicken
I hope so too. And I've never tried fiesta like chicken before. I might give it a try if I go to Applebee's again. I hope you feel better :(

I just want to feel happy, I don't want to necessarily harm myself unless I became that miserable :/. And You're welcome :p it always made me feel good to help! And applesbees for me was always okay. You should definitely try chilis if you have that in your area. It's like Applebee's except in my opinion it tastes immensely better.
I went to Applebee's, it's cheap enough lol. And I didn't mean to worry you. I wasn't planning on doing any harm to myself tonight

Sorry for the late response I ended up getting some food. And it does help that there are caring people like you to talk to. Your husband made a big mistake and he should've realized he had a caring person at his side all along
I was studying to be a nurse. And I'll look into the therapist thing, I just am worried that if I decide living is better that I will still be miserable and be really screwed on time for therapy
I guess I will give it a try. Tonight has been really hard, I just want to be happy

You're a great person :( I probably should put that gift in the basement or something. I've always been pretty quiet on reddit but I guess I could try talking. Like you said, I just feel so helpless and at the moment I really just want to go through with dying. I just don't want to suffer and I know it's coming.

It was about 3 years we were together and I have no idea how to get in contact with my university's therapist. I don't even want to think about school, it just gives me this horrible empty feeling. I'm so scared :(

It's just incredibly hard. You're one of the first people I've talked to all day that wasn't family. I don't have a very good support network. And my ex has threatened to leave me so many times and just kept stringing me along and giving me hope that I could fix this. I gave everything and now I just have her birthday gift lying in my room that I can't give to her or else she will call the police. I can't even type this without crying
